legend: origin 'captured' = real output of the named tool; origin 'synthetic' = written by hand or by a throwaway script from the tool's documented or source-code format, because no wireless hardware was available. A synthetic fixture proves the parser reads the format; it does not prove a particular chip prints it. Everything under scenarios/ is a composition of these files (plus small synthetic ip/nmcli files) used for whole-probe tests and is synthetic. Real iw output captured on hardware should be added under real/ with origin 'captured'.
